name: Zwickau (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Zwickau (quartered red and white with swans and castles).
history: Municipal flag of Zwickau; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Zwickau arms — quartered with swans and castles
